note: Family-owned (since 1995) campground on Davis Road in Ashby with wooded RV sites and rustic tent sites; weekly and 4-week rates alongside nightly. Locke Brook runs along the back of the property; Frog Pond on-site. Reserve by phone or email (no online booking system). Per operator site map, ~50+ numbered sites. The operator tells large campers to come in via Route 31 and not to enter Davis Road from West Meadow Road ('tight and winding'). --Claude
summary: Confirmed on thepinescampground.com: 2026 rates No Hook Ups $50 / 3-Way (water, electric, sewer) $55 daily, $333/$366 weekly, $1,386 for 4 weeks (fees left as recorded, unchanged), water + sewer hookups, showers (paid), laundry, store, paid wifi, phone (978) 386-7702. The site states no season, site count, amperage or booking channel beyond phone/email. Note cleaned of fee/hookup facts and the wrong 'North Quabbin' placement (the park is at 39 Davis Road, Ashby). Not waterfront confirmed: on imagery the sites are in woods east of the pin; the brook and marsh lie ~150 m west across Route 31's corridor and only a small pond sits by the entrance.
flags: PRICE GATE (borderline): the operator offers 'water, electric, and sewer hook up on rv sites' and calls the others 'rustic tent sites', so the cheapest site a 23-ft motorhome can take appears to be the 3-Way at $55/day (2026), over US$50. If the $50 'No Hook Ups' sites take RVs, the base is exactly $50 and passes. No gateway (gateways.py: none within 40 km; nearest Boston 70 km); the family has not stayed here. Worth a call: (978) 386-7702.

Possible per-person charge: the 2026 rate table lists 'Additionals: Adult 18 Years or Old $10, Children 5-17 Years $5, Pets Each $5' without saying how many people the daily rate includes. If the $10 applies to both adults it is a mandatory per-night fee and the base for two would be $70-75; most likely it is for extra campers beyond the rate's occupancy, but the page does not say.

Long-stay tests: daily rates are posted and the park advertises weekend and holiday activities for transient families; weekly and 4-week rates are offered too. The seasonal share is not published. Passes on presence (working site with phone) and price.
Email differs between pages (camp@thepinescampground.com on rates/directions, campgroundthepines@gmail.com on about/rules) - informational.
